name: National Scholarship For Post Graduate Studies
benefit: - Scholarships of Rs.15,000/- per month for 10 months in a year.
_eligibility_text:
1. Applicant must be pursuing first postgraduate degree. 
1. Applicant who have already completed a postgraduate degree are not eligible to apply.
1. Applicant must be enrolled in first year of postgraduate program.
1. Applicant must be under 30 years old.
1. Applicant must be enrolled in full-time program.
1. Applicant must be pursuing recognized postgraduate degree program.
